{{Quote|What do you think you're ''doing''?|This Gran, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Procedure" />}}
A [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was employed as a '''worker''' at the [[Bormus testing facility/Legends|testing facility]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bormus/Legends|Bormus]], where he was assigned to the [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]], a new model of [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], arrived at the facility to acquire several of the new [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] for [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Skywalker's squadron]]. The Gran initially refused their request due to a matter of procedure, but the worker gave in when Tano threatened to tell [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] that he had delayed the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I need those bombers. It's a Republic emergency.''"<br />"''They&mdash;they are not ready!|Skywalker requests the bombers from the worker|<ref name="Procedure" />}}
[[File:Bormostestingfacility.png|thumb|left|250px|The Bormus testing facility, where the Gran was employed]]
A [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] worker was employed at the [[Bormus testing facility/Legends|Bormus testing facility]], a [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bormus/Legends|Bormus]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Gran was among the workers in the testing facility assigned to the [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]], a new model of [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] currently under production in the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] line.<ref name="Procedure" />

Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] traveled to the facility with his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to obtain several of the new [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] for [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|his squadron]]. Skywalker wanted to use the bombers for his upcoming [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|attack]] on the Confederate [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]. The Gran, who assumed the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] visit to be a surprise inspection, initially refused to allow them access to the new model of bombers because it violated procedure; the bombers were still under production, and the request for the starfighters to be cleared for use by the Republic was supposed to come directly from the office of [[Ask Aak/Legends|Ask Aak]], the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. However, when Tano threatened to call [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and tell him that their mission had to be postponed because of the Gran had delayed their efforts, the worker finally allowed the two Jedi to acquire a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the starfighters.<ref name="Procedure" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|If it's a matter of datawork, you'll find my droid has uploaded all the forms you'll need into your system.''"<br />"''No, no&hellip; It's a matter of ''procedure''!|Skywalker and the Gran|<ref name="Procedure" />}}
The Gran worker closely followed his orders, and when Skywalker requested the use of some of the Y-wings, he denied the Jedi on the basis of procedure, as such a request was required to come directly from the office of Senator Aak. However, he also wished to stay out of trouble, and when Tano threatened to tell Palpatine that he was holding them up, he gave in and allowed the Jedi to acquire the fighters. The Gran had [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and brown skin.<ref name="Procedure" />

==Equipment==
While working at the testing facility, the Gran wore a blue-and-white [[Clothing|uniform]].<ref name="Procedure" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|While I imagine someone else may take it and run with it, I see Bormus as a Koensayr development plant. And the Gran being there is meant as a nod to Ask Aak appointing his friends and toadies into places of influence.|Pablo Hidalgo|<ref name="JCF" />}}
The Gran appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: Procedure]]'', a six-page [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' web comic series]] which led into "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]," the third episode in [[The Clone Wars: Season One|Season One]] of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]].<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref> The webcomic was released on [[October 6]], [[2008]].<ref name="The Clone Wars archives-tenth page">{{SWArchive|url=archives/index.html?c=d6de5d83-4da5-48ab-bf34-75cd3af8fbef&k=&page=10|text=''The Clone Wars'' archives-tenth page}}</ref> [[Pablo Hidalgo]] intended the use of a Gran at the facility to serve as an example of Senator Aak placing beings of his choice into influential situations. This is conjectural, however, as it was not confirmed in the comic.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/29267113|board=Literature|thread=Clone Wars web comics: Official thread|user=[[Pablo Hidalgo|Pabawan]]|date=2008-10-07|time=1:19 PM}}</ref>
